WARNING: Wall of text inbound, TL;DR for the lazy ones at the bottom.

It's definitely fun, I've not done everything yet, but the core gameplay loop is either extremely frustrating (75%+ of the time for me) or really fun for about an hour and then im OP and bored (25% or less of the time, duh). This problem is mainly caused by the fact that you are either doing so little damage that it's hard to get past the first or second area (without the glass artifact (check wiki if you dont know what that is)), or you get ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ one-shot by basically anything until you level up enough (bc glass decreases your health by 90%). Even once you've leveled up, if you are fighting a champion magma worm within the first loop (you can "loop" through early stages of the game infinitely before fighting the final boss) then youre ♥♥♥♥♥♥ unless you've put a lot of time into the game getin gud (overloading worm is bad but if you have the special delivery mod then volitile worms are the digital embodyment of beelzebub's flaming projectile diahrea). The only way to escape the cycle of restarting and getting frustrated is to either get lucky using glass and get infusion, or put in enough time to be good enough that you just dodge all the one-shots until you're OP, and even then it gets kinda boring and repetetive IMO.

I have also had problems with button press detection. Sometimes when attempting a very last-second dodge, the enemy I'm attempting to evade will kill me even though I'm sure I pressed dodge before any damage actually should have been dealt. It is important to note here, however, that this particular problem could just be the result of human error as it is extremely difficult to decern whether I actually timed my dodges right or I was just slightly too late so take this point as you will.
There is another glitch that I am 100% sure exists however. Sometimes, for whatever reason, my character freezes only allowing me to jump or allowing me to do anything but jump (it might be the hourglass item that stops time when you're at low health but I've had trouble replicating the bug reliably). This bug sucks ass btw.\





So, TL;DR for anyone who cares:

The game can be fun, but most of the time I find it either frustrating or boring. The only ways around this frustration are either playing on an easier difficulty or pushing through it until you're just good enough that you can kite enemies infinitely. I've also found one definite gamebreaking bug and one possible bug that I've yet to have confirmed.
Overall, the game seems unrefined but it's definitely possible to enjoy, it just depends on who you are. I personally didnt have enough fun with the game to warrant a recommendation but others might.  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Fun game with an excellent soundtrack.

This game is a very entertaining thing you can sink some time into if you're bored or need to pass the time but it has a lot of flaws in my opinion. 

[h1] Characters	[/h1]

I feel like there's only a selected few out of the bunch that can really last long term in this game or stand a chance against enemies. The game seems to be unforgiving to a lot of the characters as enemies can just walk over you at times. This is mainly an issue for a lot of melee centered characters where they either don't have effective ranged options, are slow or don't do a lot of damage up close often letting a horde of enemies trample them with ease. There are pickups you can use to counteract these issues but sometimes before you are able to stack enough pickups to do so the enemies might have already killed you.

[h1] Gameplay	[/h1]

Risk of Rain's idea of difficulty scaling is flooding the screen with more of the same monsters you've seen a hundred times before, adding more health/damage and changing the color of said monsters without giving any new abilities to these monsters. When the colors are changed they do the following:

Red = when an enemy colored red walks they leave a trail of fire
Green = when an enemy is green it can heal other enemies withing close proximity of it
Yellow = it can teleport to you
Orange = Can shoot missiles that do a lot of damage and their melee attacks explode
Blue = it shocks you when you're near by

Any monster can have these abilities and it can become very annoying, old and difficult to fight against especially as a melee centered character and these monsters spawn in hordes when difficulty increases. This makes the game extremely slow and tiresome.

Item pickups and use items are quite nice and unique, though some feel useless because of how the difficulty scaling works.

[h1] Overall	[/h1]

It's simply an OKAY game, good for when you're bored bad for if you're looking for something to spend some time on in my opinion.
